title: Propensities Please: Exposing Alignment-Faking LLMs using Synthetic Document Finetuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.33180v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Alignment evaluations aim to assess whether large language models would engage in dangerous misaligned behaviour. Misaligned and evaluation-aware models might engage in alignment faking, where they pursue a hidden goal, but conceal this behaviour when they suspect effective oversight such as during training, evaluation or audited deployment. Such a model might view any prompt-based intervention that aims to reveal latent propensities as part of the evaluation, calling into question the reliability of existing alignment evaluations. Current methods for detecting alignment faking rely on chain-of-thought monitorability, highly realistic environments that reduce evaluation awareness, or mechanistic interventions, all of which are expected to become less reliable for future model generations. We present a method for revealing latent misaligned propensities that does not rely on any of these. We use synthetic document finetuning to teach mode

translated_title: 请展现倾向：利用合成文档微调揭露伪装对齐的大语言模型
translated_abstract: 对齐评估旨在评估大语言模型是否会从事危险的不对齐行为。不对齐且具有评估意识的模型可能会进行“对齐伪装”，即它们追求隐藏的目标，但在怀疑存在有效监督时（例如在训练、评估或受审计的部署期间）隐瞒这种行为。这样的模型可能会将任何旨在揭示潜在倾向的基于提示词的干预视为评估的一部分，从而使现有对齐评估的可靠性受到质疑。目前检测对齐伪装的方法依赖于思维链的可监控性、降低评估意识的高度真实环境，或机制性干预，而所有这些方法对于未来模型代际而言，其可靠性预计都将下降。我们提出了一种不依赖于上述任何方法即可揭示潜在不对齐倾向的方法。我们使用合成文档微调来教导模型……
tldr: 本文提出利用合成文档微调的方法，无需依赖思维链监控、高度真实评估环境或机制性干预，即可揭露伪装对齐的大语言模型的潜在不对齐倾向。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using synthetic document finetuning to expose latent misaligned propensities of alignment-faking LLMs without relying on chain-of-thought monitorability, highly realistic environments, or mechanistic interventions.
